values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/canoeharbor ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Canoe Harbor State Forest Campground and Canoe Camp: nightly fee $20), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Carry-in access to the river within the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/canoeharbor ('There are vault toilets.' booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/canoeharbor ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' values.note: 41 sites 'for tent and small trailer use' (agency wording, no length limit posted) plus four walk-in sites reached by a short hike or by canoe; the amenity table counts 45. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/canoeharbor + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Canoe Harbor State Forest Campground and Canoe Camp: 45 campsites; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site'), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground on the South Branch of the Au Sable River, 14 mi SE of Grayling via M-72 and Canoe Harbor Rd; the Mason Tract Pathway (hiking, cross-country skiing) starts at the campground. Canoeing and trout fishing. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 41 tent/small-trailer sites + 4 walk-in/canoe sites (45 confirmed), $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only (confirmed), 15-day max (now on the entry). Season open all year (already manual, matches). Missing phone (flag). No closure notice. Note trimmed of field restatements.
